name: anthropic-key
title: Anthropic API key
description: An Anthropic API key, billed to your own account. Separate from signing in to Claude, which spends a subscription instead.
needed_for: Pays for Claude models with your own Anthropic API key.
justification: Agents and assistants here run on a language model, and every call is billed to someone. With this key the calls are billed to your Anthropic account. It is separate from signing in to Claude, which spends a subscription instead.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.label: API key
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.hint: Console → Settings → API keys. A workspace-scoped key works.
